about: M5 of docs/world-detail-plan.md: smoke out of the roof holes over two burning hearths, two braziers along the way to the ship. Layer and own PFX: scripts/content/harbour_motion.py layer. Positions in Gothic cm; offsets of a brazier's fire, smoke and light in its own axes, as the original braziers (OC_LOB_LIGHTER_HUGE3 by the fishers and the mole). Smoke emitters lean `tilt` degrees with the world wind (+z).

particles.why: Smoke of a hut fired without a chimney, from the hole in its roof (reports/content/remaster/harbour-motion/README.md, own smoke). LIGHTSMOKE's GROUNDFOG texture is 4 % opaque and greenish, and its particles grow 30 times into a cloud the colour of the sky. Here: the opaque grey smoke texture of the game, light grey that stays darker than lit shingle and lighter than the sky and the trees, a column that grows 6 times and thins out over 13.5 s, about 5 m high; a cone of 20 deg.
